Landing.heroTitle: Master data analytics through practical real-world business cases.
Landing.heroSubtitle: DataMboa is the practical learning platform for data analytics. Master Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python and Git directly in your browser, without setup, through real projects.
Landing.loginGateTitle: Sign in required to start learning
Landing.loginGateSubtitle: Connect to access your courses, quizzes, and browser interactive laboratories.
Landing.livePreviewSql: Microfinance DB: SELECT name, balance FROM accounts WHERE balance > 5000000;
Landing.whySubtitle: No more passive lectures disconnected from business reality. Here is our 100% practical approach:
Landing.pillar1Desc: Authentic case studies from real companies (distribution, microfinance, logistics). Learn on genuine operational data.
Landing.pillar2Desc: Practice Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Git directly in your browser, even on basic Android smartphones without software installation.
Landing.pillar3Desc: Targeted skills, ultra-light videos (~1 MB) with interactive video quizzes, and immediate automated audit of formulas and code.
Landing.pillar4Desc: Each completed track grants an official certificate with a tamper-proof code and enriches your project portfolio.
Landing.catalogTitle: 5 Complete Tracks from Beginner to Expert
Landing.catalogSubtitle: Each track is structured into 3 progressive tiers with lightweight videos and downloadable exercise sheets.
Landing.diagnosticCardDesc: Take our 5-minute diagnostic test to evaluate your skills across Excel, SQL, Python, and Power BI and unlock your target courses.
Landing.feedbackTitle: What our learners and alumni say
Landing.visitorFeedbackDesc: Our pedagogical advisors answer your questions directly on WhatsApp at 657 54 62 59: tracks, prerequisites, or enrollment help.
Landing.mobileBannerTitle: Optimized for 3G mobile networks & entry-level smartphones
Landing.mobileBannerDesc: Page weight under 300 KB, compressed ~1 MB video streams, 1-click data saver mode, and full PWA offline support.

Recruiter.heroTitle: Hire Data Analysts immediately operational on your company tools.
Recruiter.heroSubtitle: Our learners are trained on authentic business cases, evaluated in our browser laboratories (Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, Git), and certified after strict rubric grading.
Recruiter.verifyTitle: Verify the authenticity of a candidate certificate
Recruiter.verifyDesc: A candidate shared a DataMboa certificate? Enter their unique verification code (e.g., DM-EXC-2026-DEMO) to verify authenticity and practical validated skills.
Recruiter.talentPoolSubtitle: Each profile comes with a directly verifiable project portfolio.
Recruiter.contactTitle: Looking for a specific talent for your company?
Recruiter.contactSubtitle: Tell us your requirements (internship, short-term, permanent, or freelance in Douala, Yaoundé or remote). Our team will provide a qualified shortlist.
Recruiter.contactSuccess: Thank you! Your hiring request has been received. Our partnership lead will contact you within 24 business hours.

Enterprise.heroTitle: Accelerate your team's data upskilling without disrupting daily operations.
Enterprise.heroSubtitle: Do your employees spend hours on sluggish Excel files or manual reporting? DataMboa trains your teams on your actual business use cases with cohort tracking and official corporate billing.
Enterprise.benefit1Desc: Your training manager tracks completion rates, study time, and quiz scores in real-time for each enrolled employee.
Enterprise.benefit2Desc: We can anonymize your authentic datasets so your teams practice directly on their real cash-flow or sales challenges.
Enterprise.benefit3Desc: Corporate billing compliant with official business standards, eligible for ongoing vocational training funds.
Enterprise.packsTitle: 3 Proven Training Programs for Your Workforce
Enterprise.quoteTitle: Get a customized corporate quote for your company
Enterprise.quoteSubtitle: Complete the form below. We will provide a customized pedagogical and financial proposal in FCFA within 24 hours.
Enterprise.quoteSuccess: Perfect! Your B2B quote request has been transmitted. An educational advisor will contact you shortly.
